limitations: Programmatic simulation; not real insurance performance.
One simulated policy event per affected policy; unobserved real-world mechanisms remain outside this model.

selection_rule: Highest validation Average Precision, then recall at 3%, then lower Brier score; no test selection.
interpretation: Synthetic-world performance; not a real insurance guarantee.
Reference 2026-H1 has been reported before; it is a regression benchmark, not a newly untouched dataset.
2026-H2 is a later simulated holdout when available.
Candidate research does not silently replace the live reference model.
robustness_limitations: Independent synthetic worlds, with 20,000 requested claims each; no model refitting or selection.
Evaluation covers 2026 only. World size also changes historical density; differences are scenario sensitivity, not causal estimates.
These tests do not establish performance on real insurance data.
source_identity_note: Canonical GitHub commit has the identical Git tree to the local numerical experiment checkpoint; publication changes commit identity only.
